notes: 1. GHNG- = the buyer registration-number prefix on this dashboard (e.g. GHNG-1000008364-A). On the UAT test account each registration carries a -A..-K suffix per registration row (one row = one registration).

2. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT buyer account/registration in a specific journey state (e.g. an Available row during a live campaign, a Booked+KYC-pending row, a Refunded row, a zero-registration buyer, an aged/short-expiry JWT, or a valid API bearer token). State must be supplied before executing — do NOT invent IDs/units.
3. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS-Home-Dashboard; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

4. Buyer auth is Mobile-OTP only (no password). UAT mobile = 8888888888, static UAT OTP = 147258 (Buyer/CP share 147258; this is NOT the Admin/SM OTP 258369). OTP SMS is delivered via Epinet, NOT Kaleyra (BRD §8 + FSD-CORRECTION 2026-05-25). Session is a JWT.

5. Buyer portal host is https://uat.xrportal.in/ (the BARE buyer host) — NOT uat-web.xrportal.in (that host serves Admin/SM/CP). The dashboard route is /home and requires authentication; unauthenticated access redirects to / (login).

6. The dashboard is read-driven and adapts to journey state (FS 1.7): the SAME page renders different banners/badges/actions per registration status. Status badges: Available (green), Waitlisted (dark/black pill), Booked (green check), Refunded (red). Process-Status actions: 'Proceed to Confirm' (Available, live campaign), 'Complete KYC' (Booked, KYC pending), 'KYC Completed' (done), 'Pay >' in Payment Schedule (milestone due), '-' (no action). WINNER status = the only confirmed/booked state (BRD §4 rule 7).

7. NOTIFICATIONS: viewing the dashboard itself dispatches no SMS/WhatsApp/email. WhatsApp goes via Kaleyra and OTP via Epinet — neither fires on a passive dashboard load (silence-by-design is a REQUIRED assertion, not a defect). 'Silent UX is not a bug' — verify the backend side-effect (clipboard/API/downstream record) before flagging a missing toast.

8. STRAPI-DRIVEN CONTENT is OUT OF SCOPE to test at source (Strapi excluded per project constraints). The dashboard CONSUMERS of Strapi content — Allocation Banner image/message, Creative Tiles, Home Popup, Marquee — are tested ONLY for their downstream render on the buyer dashboard, never for the CMS that supplies them.

9. REAL-TIME: during a live allocation campaign the dashboard reflects WebSocket-driven state changes (BRD §7/§8: connection_established, tower_refresh, unit_sold, reallocation_notification). The dashboard itself is the registrations overview; live unit selection happens in the Allocation Experience module (/alloted). Real-time dashboard cases assert the row status/process-status updates without a manual page reload.

10. DOC_DRIFT-001 — The live dashboard header (visual-memory buyer/home-dashboard INDEX.md) shows a 'Schedule a Call' button (top-right) that opens a 'Schedule a Call' modal (Preferred Date & Time*, optional Comment textarea maxlength 200, Submit Request), and after submit becomes a 'Call Requested' button (orange/amber) that opens a 'Reschedule Call' modal. BUYER-FS-Home-Dashboard.md §1.4 does NOT list this control — it lives in the Callback Request module (BUYER-FRD §Module 10, /call-feedback). Live UI wins: these TCs are authored against the observed dashboard control. [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the dashboard 'Schedule a Call' control and the Callback Request module share one backend.

11. DOC_DRIFT-002 — The live navigation sidebar (INDEX.md) exposes: Home (/home), Registration (/register), Allotment (/alloted), Homeloan (/homeloan), Project (/project), Work Progress (/work-progress), Logout. BUYER-FRD §6 lists the route as '/alloted' (one 't') and the FS step list writes '/allotted' (two t's) — the live route is '/alloted'. BUYER-FRD §3 also lists Payment Schedule, KYC, Support Tickets, Callback as modules, but they are NOT direct sidebar links on the dashboard (reached via row actions / other entry points). Sidebar coverage follows the observed 7 links.

12. DOC_DRIFT-003 — FS 1.8 / BRD Phase-4 example unit string is '3502-Crest | 1 Bed Growth Home | 323 sq.ft.'; the live UAT account (INDEX.md) shows units such as '1201-Glory 1 Bed (323 sq.ft.)' and '1004-Grace 2 Bed (485 sq.ft.)'. The unit-string format is data-dependent; expected results assert the COLUMN renders a unit string for Booked rows, not a fixed literal.

13. GLOSSARY: 'TopAlert' = the coloured Status Alert Banner at the very top (journey-state message). 'Allocation Banner' = countdown / live-event banner below the header. 'Details' table = the registrations table (cols: Registration Number, Home Loan, Alloted Unit, Status, Process Status, Payment Schedule). 'Add Units' = green button top-right of the table. 'Allotment Closing in Xh:Ym:Zs' = the table countdown timer. 'Marquee' = scrolling announcement strip. Welcome bar text = 'Welcome, [firstName] [lastName]'.

14. NEW TCs added in this pass continue the existing TC_HOMEDASH_<TYPE>_NNN series from 051 (highest pre-existing was 050). The legacy BYR_DASH_NNN series (highest 041) is preserved verbatim and NOT extended or renumbered. No existing ID is changed.

tcs.scenario: To verify the dashboard loads at /home after login
tcs.description: Verify that a successfully authenticated buyer lands on the Home Dashboard at /home.
tcs.precond: A buyer account (mobile 8888888888) can log in on UAT.
tcs.steps:
1. Go to https://uat.xrportal.in/.
2. Enter mobile 8888888888 and request OTP.
3. Enter OTP 147258 and verify.
4. Observe the page that loads.
tcs.expected: Login succeeds and the browser lands on https://uat.xrportal.in/home with the dashboard rendered (welcome bar, Details registrations table).

tcs.scenario: To verify an authenticated buyer lands on /home
tcs.description: Verify that an authenticated buyer opening the portal is taken to the Home Dashboard with the registrations table visible.
tcs.precond: A valid buyer session (JWT) is present.
tcs.steps:
1. With a valid buyer session, navigate to https://uat.xrportal.in/home.
2. Wait for the page to finish loading.
tcs.expected: The dashboard renders within about 5 seconds showing the 'Welcome, [Name]' bar and the 'Details' registrations table; no redirect to login occurs.

tcs.scenario: To verify unauthenticated access to /home redirects to login

tcs.steps:
1. Clear storage / use an incognito window.
2. Navigate directly to https://uat.xrportal.in/home.
3. Observe the redirect.
tcs.expected: The buyer is redirected to https://uat.xrportal.in/ (login); the dashboard is not rendered and no protected data is exposed (FS 1.3 — buyer must be logged in).

tcs.scenario: To verify an expired/invalidated session redirects from /home

tcs.precond: An aged/short-expiry buyer JWT is available. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an aged/short-expiry token.
tcs.steps:
1. Load /home with an expired JWT in storage.
2. Observe the result.
tcs.expected: The expired session is rejected and the buyer is redirected to / (login). [VERIFY WITH DEV] the exact JWT lifetime and at-expiry message are not stated in the FS; confirm the redirect-to-login on expiry.

tcs.scenario: To verify the session JWT is stored after login

2. Open DevTools, Application, Storage.
3. Inspect sessionStorage/localStorage for the auth token.
tcs.expected: A JWT is stored (xr_auth_token per visual-memory notes) and is carried on subsequent dashboard API calls; navigating within the app keeps the buyer authenticated. [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the exact token key/storage location.

3. Read the HTTP status.

tcs.scenario: To verify the registrations API rejects a missing/invalid token
tcs.description: Verify that the dashboard registrations endpoint returns 401 without a valid bearer token.
tcs.precond: API access is available. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access.
tcs.steps:
1. Call the registrations endpoint with no Authorization header.
2. Call it again with a tampered token.
tcs.expected: Both calls return 401 (or 403) and no registration data is returned (BRD §7 — JWT required for all API calls).

tcs.scenario: To verify another buyer's registration cannot be viewed (data isolation)
tcs.description: Verify multi-tenant isolation — a buyer cannot see another buyer's registrations on the dashboard or via the data API.
tcs.precond: Two distinct buyer accounts exist. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a second buyer's registration id + Buyer-A token.
tcs.steps:
1. As Buyer A, attempt to request Buyer B's registration (e.g. by id) via the dashboard data API.
2. Read the response.
tcs.expected: Buyer A receives only their own registrations; Buyer B's record is not returned (403/empty). No cross-buyer data leak (BRD §7). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm server-side ownership scoping.

tcs.scenario: To verify a tampered JWT forces a redirect to login

tcs.precond: The buyer is logged in on /home.
tcs.steps:
1. Open DevTools storage and change a character in the stored JWT.
2. Reload /home.
tcs.expected: The protected dashboard API call fails with 401 and the buyer is redirected to / (login); no dashboard data is shown.

tcs.scenario: To verify auth requests are HTTPS only
tcs.description: Verify that the dashboard and its data/auth requests use HTTPS with no token in the URL.
tcs.precond: DevTools is open on /home.
tcs.steps:
1. Confirm the address bar shows https:// on /home.
